verdict.rationale: GitHub's own marketing copy directly states the capability ('Launch a full, cloud-based development environment in seconds'), matching the story almost verbatim, which points to GitHub Codespaces. However, the evidence pack offers no further detail on setup, container/config options, or independent/hands-on confirmation that spin-up genuinely takes seconds; unrelated reliability complaints in community evidence don't specifically address Codespaces launch speed. Missing for 10: technical details on Codespaces configuration/devcontainer support, independent hands-on timing confirmation, and no contradicting evidence to elevate confidence.
